shared_prompt:
Asset type: standalone mobile app navigation LINE ICON, PNG, for a calm poker-learning app with a sleepy playing-card mascot.
Strict visual system: SIMPLE MINIMAL OUTLINE ICON. Smooth rounded linecaps and rounded linejoins. All strokes one uniform bold weight equivalent to 20 pixels on a 512-pixel canvas. Primary stroke color warm ivory #F5EEDF. The ONLY accent color is muted green #227865. No other colors. Mostly outline geometry, with only a tiny accent allowed as a solid green detail. Large clear simple shapes, maximum readability at small sizes.
Do NOT draw a mascot, character, face or scene unless the requested subject specifically includes it. Subtly rounded playing-card rectangles and simple spade shapes evoke the sleepy-card brand.
Canvas: square, exactly 512x512 requested. Complete icon centered on both axes, fully inside the central 76% of the canvas. Leave at least 12% COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT clear space on each of all four sides.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, including every enclosed open space and the interiors of outlines. No background tile, plate, circle, container, rectangle, colored backdrop or checkerboard pattern.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks, shadows, glow, gradients, lighting, shading, textures, 3D, perspective depth, realistic anatomy, decorative extra objects, thin strokes, variable stroke weight, large filled silhouettes.
